who.value: kit designer or engineer building dweb prototypes

stage.value: internal tooling, not a customer journey

job.value: find which dweb components exist and whether each is real, custom or a mimic

questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Component inventory' with 'All (86) / Package (34) / Custom kit (18) / Restricted (3) / Mimic (31)' filters and component cards makes the purpose clear.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: The source filter chips and the component cards are the obvious things to use.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: Filter chips with counts and 'USED BY' links say what they show.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Package', 'Custom kit' and 'Mimic' are defined in the intro paragraph, but 'Restricted' is not.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It only asks which source to filter by.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: The maintenance warning 'Preview defined for a component no longer exported: Text, Icon.' is shown to everyone up front.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: That warning is for whoever maintains the page, not someone browsing for a component.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Two dense paragraphs about sources, previews and auto-generation come before the first component.
